name: TMK Chemical Bhd
summary: TMK Chemical Bhd engages in sourcing, processing, and distribution of inorganic chemicals and value-added services in Malaysia, Vietnam, Singapore, Indonesia, Brunei and internationally. The company operates through Provision of Total Chemical Management; Provision of Chemical Terminal Services; and Others segments. It manufactures chlor-alkali derivatives, such as sodium hydroxide; liquid chlorine; ferric, and methyl chloride; hydrochloric acid; and sodium hypochlorite. The company also provide storage facilities for bulk liquid chemicals, drumming, and transportation services; packing and warehousing services; and maintenance and related services.
